Name: ModDew Valley
Author: josuediazflores
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]ModDew Valley is a native macOS mod manager for Stardew Valley with Nexus Mods integration, modpack profiles, and a cozy Stardew-themed UI. Browse mods, toggle them on and off, create profiles to switch between setups, share them with friends over Bluetooth, and even install SMAPI right from the app.[/color]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]1. Download the ZIP file from the Files tab[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]2. Unzip Stardew Mod Manager.zip[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]3. If macOS says the app "is damaged and can't be opened," open Terminal and run: xattr -cr ~/Downloads/Stardew\ Mod\ Manager.app (adjust the path if you unzipped it elsewhere — this is normal for unsigned apps)[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]4. Drag Stardew Mod Manager.app to your Applications folder[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]5. Launch and enjoy — future updates install automatically from within the app[/color]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Mod Management[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Enable, disable, and delete mods with one click[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Bulk select to enable, disable, or delete multiple mods at once[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Undo accidental deletes within 6 seconds[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Drag and drop ZIP files or folders to import[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Dependency warnings so you never break your mod setup[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Active modpack stays in sync when you toggle mods[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Modpack Profiles[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Save different mod configurations and switch instantly[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Export as .smm files or copy to clipboard to share with friends[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Compare profiles side-by-side[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Share modpacks with nearby Macs over Bluetooth[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Nexus Mods Integration[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Browse trending, latest, and search mods with infinite scroll[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Essentials tab with curated must-have mods for new players[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Paste a Nexus URL to auto-download[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Click "Download with Manager" on Nexus (NXM protocol support)[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Quality of Life[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Welcome guide walks you through setup on first launch[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- One-click SMAPI installation[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Toast notifications confirm every action[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Sound effects for feedback (toggleable in Settings)[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Auto-updates from within the app[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Stardew and Pink theme options[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Auto-detects game path from Steam, Mac App Store, or GOG[/color]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]- macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- SMAPI installed (the app can install it for you!)[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- A Nexus Mods API key for browsing and downloading mods (free to get from your Nexus account)[/color]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- ConcernedApe for creating Stardew Valley[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Pathoschild for SMAPI[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- The Nexus Mods team for their API[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- All the mod authors who make this community amazing[/color][/size]
